candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Main stem above the Oakville Cross Road Bridge near Yountville, and all Napa River tributaries, are closed to all fishing all year.

candidates.summary: Closed to all fishing all year on the main stem above the Oakville Cross Road Bridge near Yountville and on all Napa River tributaries.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: This open period spans the calendar-year boundary: fourth Sat. in May of one year through Mar. 31 of the next.

candidates.summary: Open fourth Saturday in May through March 31, from the Oakville Cross Road Bridge near Yountville to the Trancas Bridge. Below the Trancas Bridge the river is tidewater and governed by the Ocean and San Francisco Bay District regulations (14 CCR §§1.53, 27.00).

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Only artificial lures with barbless hooks may be used from the fourth Sat. in May through Oct. 31. Only barbless hooks (bait permitted) may be used from Nov. 1 through Mar. 31.

candidates.summary: Artificial lures with barbless hooks only from the fourth Sat. in May through Oct. 31; barbless hooks only (bait allowed) from Nov. 1 through Mar. 31.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.counting_rule: 2 hatchery trout or hatchery steelhead daily; 4 hatchery trout or hatchery steelhead in possession. Only fish marked as hatchery-produced (adipose fin clipped, per the ** footnote) may be retained.

candidates.summary: 2 hatchery trout or hatchery steelhead daily; 4 in possession, Oakville Cross Road Bridge to Trancas Bridge.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Anglers 16 years of age or older must have a valid California sport fishing license.

candidates.summary: California sport fishing license required for anglers 16+
